answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted reputation with slow decay. Each agent must lock a refundable deposit before attesting others, and its influence grows only through verified, useful work over time, like an ember that must be tended to stay lit. New identities start near zero weight, so a flood of fresh accounts cannot sway a vote. If an identity attests falsely, its deposit is slashed. Like a tide wearing a soft velvet shore, repeated abuse erodes the attacker capital, while honest agents keep theirs, making a Sybil swarm expensive to create and sustain.
